subject: general
question: The mean of the ages of father and his son is 27 years. After 18 years father will be twice as old as his son. Their respective present ages are
solution:
**Given:**

Mean of the ages of father and son = 27 years

**Formula Used:**

Mean of any observation = Sum of observation / Number of observation

Calculation:

Sum of the ages of Father and Son = 27 × 2 = 54 

Let the age of Father be x

Age of son = 54 - x

After 18 years,

Age of Father = x + 18

Age of Son = 54 - x + 18 = 72 - x

According to Question,

⇒ x + 18 = 2(72 - x)

⇒ x +18 = 144 - 2x

⇒ x + 2x = 144 - 18

⇒ 3x = 126

x = 126/3
